headline: Australia's S&P/ASX 200 Index Closes 1.82% Higher
summary: Australian stock markets finished higher at the close of trade on Tuesday. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index gained 1.82%.
why: The S&P/ASX 200 is Australia's primary stock market benchmark, reflecting the performance of top listed domestic equities.

impacts.name: S&P/ASX 200
impacts.why: Broad market buying lifted the benchmark index by 1.82%.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Australian equities rallied following widespread positive sentiment across global equity markets.
